fields.summary: Autonomous plan run (no owner). Research: run.spawn (internal/api/run_spawn.go) waits in a loop on childOutcome, which ends only once the child's session record has an exit. A child that ran rhiza session done keeps its agent at the prompt, so with no daemon nothing ends it and spawn, and the conductor step waiting on it, hang until someone closes the child's pane. The engine already treats a done mark as finished for steps with until_when = done (readyForUntil, then closeSessionPane through stepRunner.ClosePane). The plan mirrors that in spawn: a done mark ends the wait with pass, and spawn closes the child's pane itself. childOutcome is shared with stepRunner.Child, which the engine's reconcileSpawns reads, so a restarted driver agrees with the spawn process. The change set serves m4-runs-hold-up, as the recent bug fixes on runs do. No questions were raised; no owner words exist.
fields.title: Plan of the spawn-waits-for-exit bug, autonomous
